data.name: AP World History
data.detailed_description:
Step into the early modern world and experience the rise of global interaction like never before. AP World History transforms major themes such as maritime empires, trade routes, cultural exchanges, and shifting power into an immersive, story-driven game designed for learning and exploration. 

  • A Narrative Simulation: Miguel, the protagonist, documents all of the various things he sees, including labor systems, castas, foods, and maritime technologies. 

  • Several Maps: Miguel journeys from Spain to Lima, Peru by ship. He isn't just in one place! 

  • Historical Cinematic Environments

  • SINGLE-PLAYER MODE

  • Historical Accuracy: Everything observed by Miguel is 100% factual and representative of 1681, the year we based our game on. 

  • 50+ original MCQs

  • Multiple original SAQs and an LEQ

data.short_description: Have you had trouble with AP World History? Don't worry! We gotchu. This historic simulation is a study tool for the AP World History exam, but in an engaging way! Rather than boringly learning vocabulary, you explore various lands in this immersive experience.
